def fill(sel, text):
    js(f"(()=>{{const e=document.querySelector('{sel}');e.scrollIntoView({{block:'center'}});e.focus();e.click();}})()")
    time.sleep(0.3)
    cdp('Input.dispatchKeyEvent', type='rawKeyDown', key='a', code='KeyA', commands=['selectAll'])
    cdp('Input.dispatchKeyEvent', type='keyUp', key='a', code='KeyA')
    type_text(text)
    time.sleep(0.3)
def setsel(name, val):
    js(f"(()=>{{const s=document.querySelector('select[name={name}]');s.value='{val}';s.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{{bubbles:true}}));s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{{bubbles:true}}));}})()")
